unlisted_practices: Deploying trained neural networks natively within the vendor scanner reconstruction pipeline (Siemens ICE via ONNX Runtime) for real-time inline quantitative MRI parameter estimation
Training neural networks on conventionally estimated labels versus ground-truth labels to improve consistency with conventional fitting

screen.reason: The study develops and demonstrates scanner-integrated machine learning for real-time inline MRI reconstruction/parameter estimation on healthy volunteers, but it evaluates the technical implementation and model performance rather than testing a specific clinical deployment practice or safeguard.
